correctness.rationale: For every odd prime 3<=p<=971 and every residue 1<=a<p, product/derivative recurrences compute P_p(a), P_p'(a), P_p''(a) exactly in F_p; an independently written full-domain C++ recurrence enumerated all 163 primes and 45,304,276 product terms, finding 144 roots, 142 below 971 with nonzero derivative, and only 194,777 double roots at 971 (second derivative 471). Independently computed e_388=473848 and e_1554=468993 modulo 971², each divisible by 971 but not 971². The infinite-level simplicity and terminality are not inferred from enumeration: they require the stated Flórez–Higuita-Diaz–Ramírez lifting/terminal criteria under e_{2a}=a P_p(a). Boundary p=3 and nonzero roots included; no claims about odd or zero-root classes or larger primes.

verified_checks: Read frozen RESULT.md and both source census implementations; source census.cpp covers p=3..971 and a=1..p-1 with no sampling; independently implemented and executed a separate C++ full-range evaluation with matching counts and derivatives.
